unhinged mental health hacks
i just found out about

an alter ego for hard days

give yourself a calm, confident alter ego and ask what they would do on your worst days. it sounds silly, but stepping outside yourself makes problems feel smaller.

rearranging your room

move your bed, desk or sofa somewhere new once a season. a room that looks different tricks your brain into feeling like a fresh start has actually begun.

the worry appointment

give your worries one fixed 15 minute slot every evening. when one shows up during the day, tell it to wait for its appointment. most of them never come back.

one new thing a day

learn one completely new thing every day in 5 minutes: a strange animal, a famous painting, how the moon moves. a brain busy with wonder has much less room for spiralling.
slides.texte_sophia:
one new thing a day

i used to spiral every night before bed. now i spend 5 minutes on one lesson in the Sophia app instead: a strange animal, a painting. a brain busy with wonder spirals less.

slides.texte_overlay:
talking to yourself kindly

talk to yourself out loud the way you would talk to a friend having a bad day. hearing kind words in your own voice works much better than you'd ever expect it to.
